Correction from the filer: this is downstream app metadata, not a platform defect. `crm_contact.full_name` is the app's own stored formula, `joinNonEmpty([record.first_name, record.last_name], ' ')` in `src/sales/objects/contact.object.ts`, and it is the object's `nameField`. The downstream will fix its formula, tracked in steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#163. Closing as not planned.
